panel.disclosure: Circle area ∝ quantity (one shared coefficient); centres are a diagram layout, not lat/lon; original boundaries, distances and full adjacency are not preserved.
panel.planSummary: {circles} drawable circles (units {total}, zero {zero}, missing {missing}); {edges} original adjacency edges; total {totalValue} {unit}
panel.planCoefficient: area coefficient k={k}, max radius {maxRadius} (diagram units)
panel.notReady: Below the publication gate ({status}) — can be saved as a diagnostic draft, not delivered as a finished product.
panel.diagnosticOptIn: I confirm this layout is below the publication gate and is applied only as a diagnostic draft (recorded as diagnostic on the layer and in the receipt)

diagram.empty: No positive-area circle to draw: zero/missing regions stay in the list and the original map — check the field or scope first.
diagram.aria: Dorling circle area cartogram (diagram coordinates; arrow keys switch region, Esc resets)
diagram.hint: wheel to zoom · drag to pan · ←/→ to switch

toast.appliedDiagnostic: Applied as a diagnostic draft (below the publication gate)
toast.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested; the server decides the terminal state
